jobs.title: Mountain Guide
jobs.description: Lead responsible trekking experiences through the mountains. Work with international guests while promoting sustainable tourism practices.
requirements: 5+ years of guiding experience in the mountains
Fluent in English plus a local language
Deep knowledge of local culture and ecology
responsibilities: Lead multi-day treks ensuring guest safety and comfort
Educate guests on local culture, ecology, and sustainability
Implement low-impact protocols on all trips
Conduct daily health checks and altitude assessments
Foster meaningful connections between guests and communities

jobs.title: Sustainability Coordinator
jobs.description: Drive our responsible travel initiatives. Measure impact, develop partnerships, and ensure all operations align with our sustainability commitments.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, or related field
3+ years in sustainability or social impact roles
Experience with impact measurement frameworks (SDGs, B Corp)
responsibilities: Track and report on sustainability KPIs
Develop partnerships with local communities and NGOs
Create educational content for guests and staff

jobs.title: Marketing & Content Creator
jobs.description: Tell the story of responsible adventure travel. Create compelling content, manage social media, and grow our community of conscious travelers.
requirements: 2+ years in content marketing or digital storytelling
Excellent writing and visual storytelling skills
responsibilities: Create blog posts, social content, and email campaigns
Manage social media channels (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn)
Document trips through photography and video
Build relationships with travel influencers and media
Analyze content performance and optimize strategy
